definitionZh: *webkit-search-cancel-button CSS伪元素代表一个键("cancel button"),位于输入类型="搜索"的边缘,可以清除输入元素的当前值. 这个按钮和伪元素是非标准的,只在WebKit和Brink中支持,因此是供应商的前缀. 清晰的按钮只在非空搜索输入元素上显示.
sourceDefinition: The ::-webkit-search-cancel-button CSS pseudo-element represents a button (the "cancel button") at the edge of an input of type="search" which clears away the current value of the input element. This button and pseudo-element are non-standard, supported only in WebKit and Blink, hence the vendor prefix. The clear button is only shown on non-empty search input elements.
